description: `sh3llpass` takes raw Meterpreter (or any) shellcode, applies **5 layers of obfuscation** (XOR → RC4 → Byte Swap → Junk Insertion → Delta), and generates a polymorphic C loader. It compiles the loader into a fully functional Windows EXE with built-in **sandbox evasion, debugger detection, and NTDLL unhooking**.
name: sh3LLpass
